title: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) FOR CONDUCTING ZATU EVALUATION
description: Zanzibar Teachers Union invites qualified consultants to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of ZATU programs, performance, and institutional capacities including review of strategies, program achievements, governance, stakeholder data collection, and production of evaluation reports.

contact.name: General Secretary, Zanzibar Teachers Union
contact.address: P.O. Box 1497, Mwanakwerekwe C, Zanzibar, Tanzania

eligibility: Consultants/firms with 3+ years experience in institutional evaluations, trade unions/NGOs; fluency in Swahili and English required.
